The Laredo Police Department has promoted two of its lieutenants to the rank of captain.

Lieutenants Monica Cazares and Jose O. Sotelo were promoted to captain, the department announced Monday, November 9. The department congratulated both officers on the promotion, calling it well deserved.

The department said the promotions reflect the two officers' dedication, leadership and professionalism, and their commitment to serving and protecting the Laredo community.

As captains, Cazares and Sotelo take on new leadership roles within the department. The department wished them continued success in this new chapter of their law enforcement careers.

Source: Laredo Police Department, November 9, 2026.
